conclusion: The specific source of the prior numerical mismatch is autograd accumulation order: reusing the CE logits view for q_left shares one slice node in the study-local graph, while sn.train creates q_left from a separate slice of all_logits. The scalar forward loss remains identical, but the backward graph sums contributions in a different order; AdamW amplifies the tiny gradient rounding delta. With the shared trainer slice construction, two-update H/A state is bitwise identical.
method: Loaded the study-local _fit_loop source with inspect.getsource into a temporary namespace; changed only q_left construction from softmax(logits) to softmax(all_logits[:, CONTEXT:CONTEXT+CORE]); did not write either source file. Compared both two-update CE runs against sn.train after loading the exact same warm-start H/A state through a temporary in-memory _copy_teacher_function override.
